notes.text:
On November 17, 2026, the OpenJDK project released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability in the hardware-accelerated Base64 decoder in the OpenJDK HotSpot JVM, commonly referred to as "Java4Shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-114938). The vulnerability is a heap-based out-of-bounds write that could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause memory corruption and potentially execute arbitrary code. 

For your system to be exposed to this vulnerability, all of the following conditions must be met:  

- An affected JVM. Including Java runtimes bundled inside products.
- Intel and AMD chips are affected in case they support a x86-64 CPU architecture with AVX-512 VBMI
- Untrusted Base64 reaching Base64.getDecoded() or getUrlDecoded()
- A JIT-compiled decoder  

Siemens is preparing fixes and recommends specific mitigations for products where fixes are not or not yet available.  

This advisory covers the status of impact of various Siemens products.
notes.title: Summary

notes.text: As a general security measure Siemens strongly recommends to protect network access to affected products with appropriate mechanisms. It is advised to follow recommended security practices in order to run the devices in a protected IT environment.

notes.text: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: Compiler).  Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u511b33-perf, 17.0.21.0.3, 21.0.13.0.3, 25.0.5.0.3, 27.0.1.0.3; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.21.0.3 and  21.0.13.0.3; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.20.0.3. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note: This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.1 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
notes.title: CVE Description

notes.text: CVE-2026-114938 affects the OpenJDK JVM used by Desigo CC Advanced Reporting. Due to Desigo CC’s secure architecture, which isolates the reporting engine via loopback addressing and requires authenticated access, the system remains protected against unauthorized network exploitation and therefore the attack surface is limited to authenticated users with the ability to proxy requests to the local Tomcat service.

remediations.details:
Update Java to a version that addresses the vulnerability once available. Until the update can be applied, add the following parameter to the client's JVM startup arguments:
-XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics
